gloss: the farthest reaches; the ends (of the earth)

definitions.gloss: the farthest reaches; the ends of the earth; the most remote place
definitions.explanation: The most distant, remote point of a region or territory. Often carries a poetic or dramatic tone.

examples.japanese: {世界|せかい}の{最果|さいは}てを{目指|めざ}す。
examples.english: I aim for the ends of the earth.

examples.japanese: ここは{日本|にほん}の{最果|さいは}ての{地|ち}だ。
examples.english: This is the most remote place in Japan.

examples.japanese: {北海道|ほっかいどう}の{最果|さいは}てにある{灯台|とうだい}を{訪|たず}ねて、{地|ち}の{果|は}てに{来|き}たという{実感|じっかん}がわいた。
examples.english: When I visited the lighthouse at the northernmost tip of Hokkaido, I truly felt like I had come to the edge of the world.

notes:
{最果|さいは}て combines {最|さい} (most, utmost) with {果|は}て (end, extremity). It has a literary, evocative quality and is often used in travel writing, poetry, and dramatic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世界|せかい}の{最果|さいは}て (the ends of the earth)
- {最果|さいは}ての{地|ち} (the most remote land)
- {最果|さいは}ての{駅|えき} (the most remote station)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {果|は}て: end, extremity — simpler and less dramatic
- {辺境|へんきょう}: frontier, remote region — more factual, used in geography and history
- {僻地|へきち}: remote area, backwater — can carry a negative connotation of underdevelopment
